meta.title: Hoi An, Vietnam🎍| BEST cafes 🍹 | Cooking Class 🍲| Vegan Vietnamese Dishes 🇻🇳| Linen Clothes🩳
meta.description:
We're excited to take oyu along on pour last stop of our 2025 Vietnam trip, this time in the beautiful Hoi An! We had such a fun 3 days exploring the UNESCO Ancient Town, some MAJOR cafe hopping, custom linen clothes, and lots of swimming!! 

We hope you have enjoyed our Vietnam 2025 series!! We loved Vietnam so much that we're going back this year!! We will be spending over 60 days traveling through 6 countries, we can't wait to take you along with us :)

Follow our travels and daily life in London on Instagram @hollyandbao
